title: 第13章 医术现学的第14章 阴阳玄针容颜恢复
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
此话一出，在场之人，无不怔住！
要知道韩枫不仅是御气八重的天才，而且还精通数种韩家武学，战力在天河城年轻一辈当中，除了那位楚天骄，能压他一头外，没有几个人可以与其争锋。
楚天铭这个瞎子，哪里来的胆量敢应战的，这家伙难道不仅瞎？还是个傻子？
然而他们并不知道。
楚天铭有两个应战的理由。
第一，他要尝试一下，自己刚刚领悟这些武技的威力。
第二，他也要证明一下自己的实力。
正如韩枫所说，想要获得韩家之人的认可，就必须要拿出实力，而这一战，也是他证明自己的最好机会！
“好，很好，你虽然没有你哥哥楚天骄的实力，但是却比他更有胆量！”
韩枫嘴角一扬，右手一翻，掌心当中，赫然多出了一株散发着浓郁灵气的白色灵芝，开口道：“三天后，我们就在韩家演武场比试，若是你赢了，韩某便将手里这株千年雪莲给你，若是你输了的话，就自己滚出韩家！”
“我去，千年雪莲啊，这可是昂贵的灵草，据说炼化一株千年雪莲，抵得上炼化一百粒练气丹。”
“是啊，没想到韩枫师兄，竟然将这么珍贵的东西都拿出来当赌注了。”
“呵呵，那有什么的，你觉得凭这小子，能挡住韩枫师兄三招？开玩笑呢，韩枫师兄根本输不了的。”
“这倒也是！”
众人议论纷纷，似乎没人看好楚天铭能够赢下。
楚天铭面无表情道：“这可是你说的，希望你不要反悔。”
“你放心，韩某一向说到做到，不过前提是你能赢我才行！”
韩枫面带不屑。
“那我们三天后，演武场上见。”
楚天铭心里冷笑两声，不再多言，直接绕开韩枫等人，向着远处走去。

……
回到了家里，看到韩清雪的房门紧闭，楚天铭心里不免有些担心，当即来到了门前，低声询问：“清雪，你在里面么？”
“嗯，我在里面，你……你有事情么？”
韩清雪的声音有些慌乱。
“你怎么了？遇到什么事情？”
楚天铭皱了下眉头，伸手直接推开了房门，然后走入了韩清雪的闺房当中。
走入房门，便迎面看到墙壁上挂着一幅山水画，画中的山峦叠嶂，水波涟漪，有百鸟齐飞，让人仿佛身处山水当中，宁静而又深远。
而房间的一角则摆放着一张古色古香的琴桌，上面搁着一把精致的古琴。
窗棂下的书桌上则摆放着各类书籍。
房间虽然不大，但是装饰却淡雅而精致。
此时，韩清雪就呆坐在内屋的床铺之上，脸上戴着一层白色面纱。
看到楚天铭走入，她眼中不禁闪过一丝惊慌，问道：“你……你怎么进来了？”
“我媳妇的房间，难道我不许来么？”
楚天铭笑着反问道。
“我……我今天不舒服，有什么事情，明天再说吧。”
韩清雪螓首微垂，眼神躲闪。
“哪里不舒服，我给你看看。”
楚天铭向着韩清雪看去，虽然韩清雪带着一层面纱，可是对他的轮回天目而言，这层面纱并没有任何用处。
只见，韩清雪那张脸上的红斑，比前几天不仅更大，而且更红，几乎连到了一起，丑陋到了极点。
“怎么会这样。”
content_en:
As soon as these words came out, everyone present was stunned!
You must know that Han Feng is not only a genius at the eighth level of Qi Control, but also proficient in several Han family martial arts. Among the younger generation in Tianhe City, few people can compete with him except Chu Tianjiao, who can beat him.
How could a blind man like Chu Tianming have the courage to accept the challenge? Isn't this guy just blind? Still a fool?
However they don't know.
Chu Tianming had two reasons to challenge.
First, he wanted to try it. He had just realized the power of these martial arts.
Second, he also has to prove his strength.
As Han Feng said, if he wants to be recognized by the Han family, he must show his strength, and this battle is also his best chance to prove himself!
"Okay, very good. Although you are not as strong as your brother Chu Tianjiao, you are more courageous than him!"
Han Feng raised the corner of his mouth, turned his right hand, and in the palm of his hand, a white Ganoderma lucidum exuding strong aura suddenly appeared, and said: "In three days, we will compete at the Han family's martial arts field. If you win, Han will give you the thousand-year-old snow lotus in his hand. If you lose, get out of the Han family!"
"Let me go, Millennium Snow Lotus, this is an expensive spiritual grass. It is said that refining one Millennium Snow Lotus is equivalent to refining a hundred Qi Training Pills."
"Yes, I didn't expect that Senior Brother Han Feng would take out such precious things as bets."
"Haha, what's the matter? Do you think this kid can block Senior Brother Han Feng's three moves? You're kidding, Senior Brother Han Feng can't lose at all."
"That's true!"
Everyone was talking a lot, but no one seemed to be optimistic that Chu Tianming could win.
Chu Tianming said expressionlessly: "This is what you said, I hope you won't regret it."
"Don't worry, Han always does what he says, but only if you can beat me!"
Han Feng looked disdainful.
"Then we'll meet at the martial arts field in three days."
Chu Tianming sneered in his heart, said nothing more, directly bypassed Han Feng and others, and walked towards the distance.
…
After returning home, Chu Tianming couldn't help but feel a little worried when he saw Han Qingxue's door was closed. He immediately came to the door and asked in a low voice: "Qingxue, are you in there?"
"Well, I'm inside, you...are you okay?"
Han Qingxue's voice was a little panicked.
"What's wrong with you? What happened?"
Chu Tianming frowned, reached out and pushed open the door, and then walked into Han Qingxue's boudoir.
When you walk into the door, you will see a landscape painting hanging on the wall. In the painting, there are mountains, ripples, and hundreds of birds flying together. It makes people feel like they are in the middle of the landscape, peaceful and far-reaching.
In the corner of the room is an antique piano table with an exquisite guqin resting on it.
Various books are placed on the desk under the window lattice.
Although the room is not large, the decoration is elegant and exquisite.
At this time, Han Qingxue was sitting on the bed in the inner room, wearing a white veil on her face.
Seeing Chu Tianming walking in, she couldn't help but a flash of panic in her eyes, and asked: "You...why did you come in?"
"Am I not allowed to come to my wife's room?"
Chu Tianming asked with a smile.
"I...I'm not feeling well today. If there's anything else, let's talk about it tomorrow."
Han Qingxue lowered her head slightly and looked away.
"I'll show you where you feel uncomfortable."
Chu Tianming looked at Han Qingxue. Although Han Qingxue was wearing a veil, this veil was of no use to his reincarnation third eye.
I saw that the red spots on Han Qingxue's face were not only larger but also redder than the previous few days. They were almost connected together, making it extremely ugly.
"how so."
